comment: Gun effects in a live match on Larak Lot, first person, through ordinary input, from the TOLL north spawn: the Railgun into an enamel toll booth, Rifle rounds into the concrete west wall and the booth, a Shotgun blast into the wall, then the marks they left. Run tools/qa_tour.sh with FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/combat-vfx.json, FRAGR_QA_MAP=1, FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0, FRAGR_QA_NO_ROUND_EVENTS=1 and FRAGR_QA_MUTATORS=full-arsenal, so every arcade gun is owned from the first tick. The Rocket is res://qa/combat-vfx-rocket.json; the controlled lineup is client/qa/combat_vfx_review.gd. Inspection only; not a tour publish.

states.name: vfx_join
states.note: TOLL north, the Railgun up, an enamel toll booth five metres off.

states.name: vfx_rail_booth
states.note: The beam from the held gun, its spiral and lingering core, the ring on the booth.

states.name: vfx_rifle_concrete
states.note: A Rifle round into concrete: dust and grit, and a pock left behind.

states.name: vfx_rifle_enamel
states.note: A Rifle round into the enamel booth: sparks and a bright dent.

states.name: vfx_scatter_wall
states.note: A Shotgun blast into concrete: seven puffs and seven pocks.

states.name: vfx_marks
states.note: What the shots left on the TOLL wall.
